targets.title: Scout
targets.subtitle: scout
targets.bio: Owns Scout, the macOS menu-bar app that records spoken feedback with screen context and sends it to agents: recording, transcription, the target picker and delivery.

targets.title: Apiary
targets.subtitle: apiary
targets.bio: Owns Apiary, the desktop app and kernel for Champions, Projects and bees: chat, Inbox, Forum, proofs and landing.

targets.title: Honeybee
targets.subtitle: hive
targets.bio: Owns hive, the CLI and daemon that runs agent sessions (bees), cells, mailboxes and transcripts.

targets.title: Pollinate
targets.subtitle: pollinate
targets.bio: Owns Pollinate: schedules, webhooks, event polls and routers that wake agents.

targets.title: Nectar
targets.subtitle: nectar
targets.bio: Owns nectar, the preview server: tailnet URLs for prototypes, desktop testpacks and public nctr.site links.

targets.title: Hem
targets.subtitle: hem
targets.bio: Owns Hem, the secret store: hem get and set, approval prompts and per-agent grants.

targets.title: Foundation
targets.subtitle: foundation
targets.bio: Owns Foundation, the document format and renderer behind docs, decks and handbooks.

targets.title: Scout Site
targets.subtitle: scout-site
targets.bio: Owns scout.honeybee.dev, Scout's marketing site, download page and user guide.

targets.title: Fjordbank Web
targets.subtitle: fjordbank-web
targets.bio: Owns the Fjordbank customer web bank at nettbank.fjordbank.no: login, accounts, payments and onboarding.

targets.title: Fjordbank App
targets.subtitle: fjordbank-app
targets.bio: Owns the Fjordbank iOS and Android app: BankID login, card controls and push notifications.

targets.title: Ledger
targets.subtitle: ledger
targets.bio: Owns Ledger, a personal budgeting app for macOS and iOS in SwiftUI: accounts, categories, budgets and charts.

targets.title: Kitchen
targets.subtitle: kokebok
targets.bio: Owns kokebok.thto.no, the family recipe site, and its weekly meal planner and shopping list.

targets.title: Scout: smart target suggestion (Jev) + safe send

targets.bio: Grouped picker sections with counts, Apiary looks on rows, Tab and Shift-Tab between groups.

targets.bio: New layout for Forum packets, review threads and the proof card inside a packet.

targets.title: Apiary: Inbox triage
targets.bio: Inbox filters, snooze, keyboard triage and batch accept for proofs.

targets.title: Nectar: public nctr.site URLs
targets.bio: Public share links on nctr.site with expiry, passwords and access logs.

targets.title: Pollinate: GitHub PR router
targets.bio: Route GitHub pull request events to the right bee, with debounce and batching.

targets.title: Fjordbank: onboarding v3
targets.bio: New customer onboarding in the web bank: BankID, know-your-customer questions and opening the first account.

targets.title: Fjordbank: payments redesign
targets.bio: New payment and transfer screens in the web bank: recurring payments, eFaktura and the confirmation step.

targets.title: Ledger: CloudKit sync
targets.bio: Sync accounts, budgets and transactions between Mac and iPhone through CloudKit, with conflict handling.
